message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to weather data. However, I can give you a quick overview of what you can generally expect in San Francisco:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|-----------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | Mild, temperatures usually range from 48–58 °F (9–14 °C). Fog and drizzle are common, especially in the mornings. |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | Cool and often cloudy; temperatures 50–65 °F (10–18 °C). Occasional rain showers. |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | Warm but rarely hot; daytime highs 60–75 °F (16–24 °C). Coastal breezes keep it comfortable, and fog can linger in the early morning. |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | Similar to summer, with temperatures 60–70 °F (16–21 °C). Rain starts increasing toward late fall. |

If you need the current forecast, you might want to check a reliable weather service such as the National Weather Service, Weather.com, or a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like help finding a specific source or if there’s anything else I can do!
